name: Airtable
description: Production-grade integration with Airtable REST API. Free-tier optimized with automatic 429 rate-limit backoff, auto-chunked batch operations up to 100 records, capacity monitoring, and airlock governance. contest:round2 contest:2026Q3

commands.name: create_record
commands.description: Add a new record to the specified Airtable table. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table in the base

fields.description: Key-value mapping of field names to values for the new record

typecast.description: Perform best-effort automatic data conversion (e.g. string to choice)

commands.title: Create Record

commands.name: update_record
commands.description: Update fields on an existing record in an Airtable table (PATCH). Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_id.description: The Airtable record ID to update (e.g. recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)

fields.description: Key-value mapping of field names to update

commands.title: Update Record

commands.name: delete_record
commands.description: Permanently delete a record from an Airtable table. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_id.description: The Airtable record ID to delete (e.g. recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)

commands.title: Delete Record

commands.name: get_record
commands.description: Retrieve a single record by its record ID from an Airtable table.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_id.description: The Airtable record ID to retrieve (e.g. recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)

commands.title: Get Record

commands.name: list_records
commands.description: List records from an Airtable table with optional filtering, sorting, view restrictions, and pagination.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

max_records.description: Total maximum number of records to return (defaults to 100, max 1000)

offset.description: Pagination cursor token returned by a previous list call

view.description: Name or ID of a view in the table to limit results to

fields.description: Subset of field names to include in each returned record

commands.title: List Records

commands.name: search_records
commands.description: Filter records in an Airtable table using a formula expression (e.g. {Status}='Done').

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

filter_by_formula.description: Airtable formula string to evaluate against each record

max_records.description: Maximum number of matching records to return (default 100)

commands.title: Search Records

commands.name: list_tables
commands.description: List all tables and field schema definitions in a given Airtable base.
commands.title: List Tables

commands.name: batch_create_records
commands.description: Create up to 100 records in batch in an Airtable table (automatically chunked into Airtable 10-record subrequests). Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

fields.description: Key-value mapping of field names to values

records.description: Array of up to 100 record objects to create (auto-chunked)

commands.title: Batch Create Records

commands.name: batch_update_records
commands.description: Update up to 100 records in batch (PATCH), automatically chunked into 10-record subrequests. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

fields.description: Key-value mapping of fields to update

records.description: Array of up to 100 record objects with id and fields (auto-chunked)

commands.title: Batch Update Records

commands.name: batch_delete_records
commands.description: Delete up to 100 records in batch, automatically chunked into 10-record subrequests. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_ids.description: Array of up to 100 Airtable record IDs to delete (auto-chunked)

commands.title: Batch Delete Records

commands.name: batch_upsert_records
commands.description: Insert or update up to 100 records matching on key fields (upsert), automatically chunked into 10-record subrequests. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

fields_to_merge_on.description: Field names used to determine whether a record already exists

fields.description: Key-value mapping of field names to values

records.description: Array of up to 100 record objects to upsert (auto-chunked)

commands.title: Batch Upsert Records

commands.name: list_bases
commands.description: List all Airtable bases accessible by the current token.

offset.description: Pagination cursor token returned by previous call

commands.title: List Bases

commands.name: add_comment
commands.description: Add a comment to an Airtable record. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_id.description: The record ID to comment on (e.g. recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)

commands.title: Add Comment

commands.name: list_comments
commands.description: List comments on a record with pagination.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

record_id.description: The record ID to inspect (e.g. recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)

commands.title: List Comments

commands.description: Create a new table with fields in an Airtable base. Requires airlock approval.

name.description: The name of the new table

type.description: Field type (e.g. singleLineText, multilineText, number, checkbox, singleSelect)

options.description: Field configuration options (e.g. choices for singleSelect)

fields.description: Array of initial field definitions for the table

commands.name: create_field
commands.description: Add a new column (field) to an existing table. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

type.description: Field type (e.g. singleLineText, number, date, checkbox, singleSelect, email, url)

options.description: Optional field options depending on type

commands.description: Update table name or description. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table to modify

commands.description: Update field name or description. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

field_id.description: The ID or name of the field to update

commands.name: list_webhooks
commands.description: List all configured webhooks for an Airtable base.

commands.description: Count total records in an Airtable table and monitor Free Tier limit capacity (1,000 record ceiling).

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

view.description: Optional view name or ID to count records within

filter_by_formula.description: Optional Airtable formula to filter counted records

commands.title: Count Records & Capacity Monitor

commands.name: sync_and_notify
commands.description: Compound automation: Upsert records matching on unique keys and attach audit comments. Requires airlock approval.

table_name.description: The name or ID of the table

fields_to_merge_on.description: Field names used to determine whether a record already exists (e.g. ['Email'])

fields.description: Key-value mapping of field names to values

records.description: Array of up to 100 record objects to upsert (auto-chunked)

notify_text.description: Optional audit note to post as a comment on modified records

max_comments.description: Maximum number of modified records to attach comments to (default 10)

commands.title: Sync Records & Notify
